item.title: Cass St Trick 'R' Treat — Oct 24, 2026
item.description:
Omaha Conservatory of Music:, 7023 Cass St, Omaha, NE, 68132, United States Saturday, October 24, 2026 · 9:00 AM Bring the whole family for a ghoulishly good time at Cass Street Trick ‘R’ Treat – a completely FREE and family-friendly Halloween Carnival presented by Omaha Conservatory of Music, Omaha Community Playhouse, and Omaha Academy of Ballet.
Play games, win candy, and get your ghastly groove on with our delightfully spooky zombie orchestra. Dress up if you dare – costumes are encouraged! Don’t miss this spectacularly spooky and seriously FUN event. Happy haunts!
WHEREOmaha Conservatory of Music7023 Cass St. Omaha, NE 68132 WHENOctober 24 from 9 AM–12 PM WHOThe whole family! Source: Omaha Conservatory of Music

item.title: Final Fridays @ the Conservatory — Sep 26, 2026
item.description:
Omaha Conservatory of Music:, 7023 Cass St, Omaha, NE, 68132, United States Saturday, September 26, 2026 · 12:00 PM FINAL FRIDAYS @ THE CONSERVATORY — September 25, 2026 — 12 PM
End your month on the right note by joining us for Final Fridays @ the Conservatory! In recognition of the 25th anniversary of September 11, this month’s America 250-themed concert is dedicated to the first responders who serve our community. First responders and their families are invited to enjoy reserved seating and special recognition.
Enjoy a free Artist/Faculty performance featuring Dr. Gabrielle Molina on viola and Yulia Kalashnikova on piano. Then stay for great company and complimentary coffee, courtesy of Myrtle & Cypress. The performance begins around 12:10 p.m. Light bites will be available for purchase from Myrtle & Cypress.
Entry is free. RSVP here. Source: Omaha Conservatory of Music
